versions.changelog:
- Added protocol and documentation for single-action and action-sequence motion control (see new references/phoenix-*.md, action-sequence.md).
- Added support for dance routines with a fixed ~45s “showcase_custom” preset (see references/dance-routines.md).
- Expanded sound control: clarified `playSound` handling for `category` and `file` payloads for mood-specific barking.
- Updated documentation to explain motion control JSONs, timing limits, and error prevention.
- Removed obsolete documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Default gateway clarified as Mainland China (https://open.ecovacs.cn); non-China regions supported with override.

- Initial release of Ecovacs Pet (FAMIBOT) control for the Open Platform.
- Rename and refocus the skill for FAMIBOT/pet robots, using POST /robot/skill/pet/cmd APIs.
- Document device discovery, the pet command allowlist, supported queries/settings, and basic troubleshooting.
- Add user guides for access key setup, device matching, HTTP and script-based control.
- Add new reference docs: `schema.md` (fields/cmds) and `troubleshooting.md` (error handling); remove internal agent documentation.
